name: Iron & Folate Citrus Spinach Super Salad
description: A crisp, nutrient-packed salad pairing non-heme iron from fresh spinach and pumpkin seeds with vitamin C rich oranges for maximum bio-absorption.
ingredients: Pinch of Sea Salt & Cracked Black Pepper
instructions: Wash baby spinach thoroughly and pat dry with paper towels.
In a large bowl, combine baby spinach, citrus orange segments, cooked lentils, and roasted pumpkin seeds.
Whisk olive oil, fresh lemon juice, sea salt, and black pepper in a small ramekin to create the dressing.
Drizzle dressing evenly over salad, toss gently, and serve immediately.

name: Pan-Seared Wild Salmon with Herb Sweet Potato Mash
description: Omega-3 rich wild salmon providing high-potency Vitamin D, B12, and Iodine, alongside beta-carotene packed roasted sweet potato mash.
ingredients: Sea Salt and Cracked Black Pepper to taste
instructions: Boil diced sweet potatoes in salted water for 15 minutes until fork-tender, then mash with olive oil and rosemary.
Season salmon fillets generously with salt, pepper, and garlic powder.
Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat. Sear salmon skin-side down for 4-5 minutes until crispy.
Flip salmon and cook for another 3 minutes until medium-rare to medium.
Plate salmon over hot sweet potato mash and enjoy.

name: Magnesium-Rich Almond & Berry Greek Yogurt Bowl
description: Creamy Greek yogurt layered with toasted almond slices, chia seeds, and fresh berries to rebuild calcium, magnesium, and gut health.
ingredients: 1 tsp Pure Maple Syrup or Honey
instructions: Scoop Greek yogurt into a chilled serving bowl.
Top with fresh blueberries and raspberries.
Sprinkle raw sliced almonds and pumpkin seeds evenly over the top.
Drizzle with honey or maple syrup before serving.

name: Golden Turmeric Lentil & Spinach Stew
description: Hearty plant protein stew loaded with iron, zinc, and magnesium from brown lentils, spinach, and anti-inflammatory spices.
instructions: Sauté onion and garlic in olive oil until translucent (about 5 minutes).
Add ground turmeric, cumin, cubed sweet potato, and rinsed lentils. Stir for 2 minutes to toast spices.
Pour in vegetable broth, bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 25 minutes until lentils are soft.
Stir in chopped spinach during the last 3 minutes of cooking until wilted. Serve hot with a squeeze of fresh lemon.
